about: A replay of the board task's first screenshot, outside the series and with no VM: Codex (0.167.0) at medium effort got one screenshot that hyprmasq returned in the image size probe, or a variant of it, and the task's comparison prompt, and gave the pixel where it would drop each label. A cell is IMAGE:MODEL:WORD, WORD the browser the prompt names. Variants: -down N moves the whole screenshot down N pixels, ffpage-crchrome puts Firefox's page under Chromium's toolbar, crpage-ffchrome the reverse. cpu is where the CPU power headers label would land, by the page's layout log of the run the image came from.
